tasks.summary: Design handoff: preserve the existing family-archive product and redesign it as a warm, editorial “living registry,” not a generic dashboard. Public visitors arrive at /, enter /tree, pan/zoom or search for relatives, open a member detail panel, follow shareable /tree?focus=<id> links, and export the tree. The keeper signs in at /admin/login and uses /admin, /admin/new, and tree editing/settings controls to maintain people, relationships, photos, and family identity. Keep /api/export and /api/photos/[name] as integration endpoints. Use a restrained parchment background (#F7F4EC), deep evergreen ink (#20372C), muted sage (#758775), warm brass accent (#A47745), and high-contrast ivory cards; preserve gender/custom person colors as secondary identification rather than relying on color alone. Pair an expressive serif display face with a legible sans body and monospace micro-labels; use an 8px spacing rhythm, 44px minimum touch targets, clear 2px focus rings, and reduced-motion fallbacks. Landing: compact branded masthead, strong family-name hero and primary Explore action, editorial summary/preview, clear keeper entry. Tree: persistent top toolbar with family identity, searchable member picker and export; expansive dotted canvas with legible generation bands, zoom/fit/minimap controls, and a right-side detail drawer on desktop. At narrow widths, collapse secondary toolbar actions into labeled menus, make search full-width when activated, place controls above the safe-area inset, and present details/editing as a scrollable bottom sheet; avoid clipping the canvas or modal controls. Provide explicit empty, loading, no-search-results, selected, hover, keyboard-focus, disabled, pending-save, validation-error, and destructive-confirmation states. Search results and menus should expose keyboard navigation, Escape dismissal, appropriate expanded/selected semantics and return focus; modal dialogs should trap focus and restore it. Preserve URL focus behavior, pointer pan and cursor-centered zoom, keyboard +/-/0/f shortcuts, PNG/GEDCOM/JSON/CSV export, and admin-only mutation boundaries. Implementation file list: src/app/globals.css and layout.tsx for tokens/type/global accessibility; src/app/page.tsx for landing; src/app/tree/page.tsx and src/components/tree/TreeExplorer.tsx for explorer shell/responsiveness; DetailPanel.tsx, MemberForm.tsx, SettingsModal.tsx and shared components under src/components/ for consistent cards/forms/dialogs; src/app/admin/** for keeper screens. Keep src/lib/actions.ts, auth.ts, queries.ts, tree-layout.ts, export-png.ts, photo.ts, src/db/** and src/app/api/** behavior intact unless a UI contract specifically requires a coordinated change. No files were changed and no server was run.
